name: bear-hard
prompt: Create one transparent RGBA game character sprite: the exact BLUE PLUSH BEAR BOBO sitting in his BLUE CLOUD-DECORATED FLOWERPOT, using reference 1 for character identity, royal-azure blue fur, cream muzzle and inner ears, brown nose, green paired leaves, same pot silhouette/color/light-blue puffy cloud decorations and small circle decorations. Reference 2 is ONLY headband color and overall scale placement. CRITICAL NEW POSE -- DO NOT COPY EITHER REFERENCE'S RAISED-ARM CHEERING POSE. Both arms are bent with ELBOWS DOWN tight beside the torso; BOTH LITTLE PAWS ARE CLENCHED INTO FISTS HELD CLOSE IN FRONT OF THE UPPER CHEST, immediately BELOW THE CHIN, like saying 'Let's do this!' and pumping oneself up before a challenge. Both fists at chest height near each other, never raised beside the ears or above the cheeks; no arms stretched sideways/upward, no victory cheer, no waving. Fists show soft curled plush fingers/knuckle folds and tucked thumbs, no human fingers or fingernails. Expression: eyes OPEN and focused with small natural catchlights, slightly drawn-together eyebrows, determined but very cute and friendly; mouth OPEN calling encouragement, cream muzzle retained, small tongue visible; not anger, not fear, not closed-eye cheering. Wear a RED CLOTH HEADBAND #E8322E across the FOREHEAD ABOVE THE EYEBROWS. The entire eyes and eyebrows remain unobscured. Band tied in one small neat knot on screen RIGHT with TWO SHORT red ribbon tails extending slightly outward, all fully within canvas. Fine fabric seams and folds in band, not a flat crude drawn polygon. Plush bear light comes softly from UPPER RIGHT, furry 3D and round, matching reference 1. Same BLUE CLOUD POT and TWO BIG GREEN LEAVES in front of the lower torso; do not swap pot for a paw-print pot or orange pot. Both elbows attach naturally to the shoulders; paws clearly in FRONT of chest ABOVE the leaves, not mounted on pot sides. Entire character and pot visible, portrait ratio 360:400 with modest transparent padding, ears, headband tails and fists all fully inside canvas. ONLY the sprite. No text, no stars, no sparkles, no badge circle, no white outline, no flames, no glow, no confetti, no background or floor shadow. A static one-frame 'fists ready / give myself encouragement' stance, absolutely NOT raised-arm cheering.
